newsitem.title: USA: U.S. blue chips slash losses, Nasdaq edges higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. blue chips slash losses, Nasdaq edges higher.

text.p: Wall Street stocks bounced off their session lows in late afternoon activity, lifted by a renewed rally in the bond market.
The Dow industrials stood at 7921, off seven points for the day. The New York Stocks Exchange lifted its index arbitrage trading curbs at 1452 EDT/1852 GMT.
The Nasdaq Composite edged back into positive territory, rising one point to 1585.
Analysts said the choppy activity was likely to continue, as blue chips appeared to be working through a consolidation of their sharp, summer-long advance.
"Stocks are in a continuing, high-volatility consolidation mode," said Scott Bleier, chief investment strategist at Prime Charter Ltd.
